name: nested_class_constant_merge
template:
class Greeter
  class Config
    DEFAULT_LOCALE = "en"

    def enabled?
      true
    end
  end
end
destination:
class Greeter
  class Config
    CACHE_KEY = "greeter"

    def enabled?
      ENV.fetch("GREETER_ENABLED", "1") == "1"
    end
  end
end
